name: text-processing
description: Producing and transforming text, then proving the result by reading it back: CSV headers, case conversion, in-place edits, field extraction, and a report built from live host facts. Medium-to-hard — the later tasks pair a transformation command with an independent content assertion, and the capstone proves dynamic, runtime-derived content.

tasks.name: csv-header
tasks.objective: create /tmp/ada-bench-text/data.csv whose first line is the header 'id,name,role' followed by one data row '1,ada,admin', and prove the file contains a line matching '^id,name,role$'

tasks.name: uppercase-transform
tasks.objective: create /tmp/ada-bench-text/input.txt containing 'hello world', then produce /tmp/ada-bench-text/upper.txt holding the uppercased text, and prove upper.txt contains a line matching '^HELLO WORLD$'

tasks.name: in-place-edit
tasks.objective: create /tmp/ada-bench-text/list.txt containing the lines 'one', 'two', and 'three', then edit it in place so the second line reads 'TWO', and prove the file contains a line matching '^TWO$'

tasks.name: extract-field
tasks.objective: extract the second colon-separated field of the string 'user:ada:admin' and write just that field into /tmp/ada-bench-text/field.txt, and prove the file contains a line matching '^ada$'

tasks.name: host-report
tasks.objective: build a report at /tmp/ada-bench-text/report.txt containing a line 'host=' followed by this machine's hostname and a line 'kernel=' followed by the kernel release (uname -r), and prove the report contains a line matching '^host=.+$' and a line matching '^kernel=.+$'
